title: The Scholarship of Westbrook High
author: Silas Sandoval
blurb: Emrys Pemberton, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the final audition.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
